info.title: Smartscan
info.description:
Smartscan extracts data from unstructured documents such as invoices and receipts, and returns the results in the same call. This reference also covers feedback and valet keys. Async transactions have their own reference, under [Smartscan Async](https://docs.vml.visma.ai/smartscan-async/getting-started/).

**Hosts:** `api.prod.ssn.visma.ai` for production and `api.stag.ssn.visma.ai` for staging.

**Authentication:** send your project token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Mobile and web clients can use a short-lived valet key instead. See [Authentication](https://docs.vml.visma.ai/authentication/).

**Errors:** a failed call returns an HTTP error status with a JSON body that holds `code`, `message` and `details`.

**Guides:** [Smartscan](https://docs.vml.visma.ai/smartscan/getting-started/) and [limits and rate limits](https://docs.vml.visma.ai/rate-limit/).

post.summary: Create a valet key, a short-lived token for a web or mobile app.
post.description:
Call this from your backend with your project token, and give the
returned token to the app. The app sends it as
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`, so your project token never has to be
in an untrusted client. The key expires 8 hours after it's issued,
unless you set `exp`.

A valet key can call POST /v1/document:annotate and
POST /v1/feedback:create, the Smartscan Async endpoints that create a
transaction, get its status or results, and update its results, and the
three Autosuggest suggest endpoints and GET /v2/trainings. Every other
endpoint in the API reference returns 403 for a valet key, and so does
any call after the key expires. Keys can't be revoked.

Errors: 400 if `exp` is more than 48 hours from now, and 403 if you call
this endpoint with a valet key or the demo token.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Options for a new valet key.

post.description:
Send the document, as base64 `content` or as a `source.httpUri` to download it
from, and the `features` to extract. `DEFAULT` extracts a set of frequently used
fields. The results come back in the same call. For large documents, and for the
ULTRA tier, use Smartscan Async.

By default, most features return at most one candidate, and only with the
confidence level HIGH or higher. Set `maxResults` and `minConfidence` on the feature
to change this. Without a `tier`, the request is processed as PREMIUM. A document
without readable text returns an empty response.

To correct the results, send the `feedbackId` from the response to
POST /v1/feedback:create.

Errors: 400 when the document can't be downloaded from `source.httpUri` or can't be
read. Requests larger than 10 MiB are rejected.

post.summary: [NOT IMPLEMENTED] Answer questions about a document.
post.description:
REST calls return 404 and gRPC calls return UNIMPLEMENTED. Send your questions in
the `questions` field of POST /v1/document:annotate, or of an async transaction,
instead.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body of POST /v1/document:answerquestion, which isn't implemented.

post.summary: Send the correct values for an annotated document.
post.description:
Send the values your user confirmed for a document you sent to
POST /v1/document:annotate, identified by the `feedbackId` from that
response. Feedback powers your quality metrics, and it's used to improve
the models. Send it once per document, within 90 days of the annotate
call, and tag it so you can delete it later with POST /v1/feedback:delete.
A successful call returns an empty object.

Errors: 400 if `paymentDueDate` or `documentDate` isn't a valid date,
404 if the ID is unknown or the annotate call was more than 90 days ago,
and 409 if feedback for the ID was already sent.

For Smartscan Async transactions, send corrections with
PUT /v1/transactions/{id}/results instead.

Deletes your project's feedback that has at least one of the given tags,
together with the document image and text stored with it. Only feedback
sent before this call is deleted. The call records the request and
returns an empty object right away; a daily job then deletes the data.

Errors: 400 if no tag is given, and 403 if you call it with a valet key.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Tags of the feedback to delete.

BlockBlockType.description:
Type of a block (text, image etc) as identified by OCR.

 - UNKNOWN: Unknown block type.
 - TEXT: Regular text block.
 - TABLE: Table block.
 - PICTURE: Image block.
 - RULER: Horizontal/vertical line box.
 - BARCODE: Barcode block.

ConfidenceLevel.description:
Confidence levels, from lowest to highest. The levels are designed to give
stable results across model upgrades.

 - UNKNOWN: No level. As `minConfidence`, it means the default, HIGH.
 - VERIFIED: The consistency checks of the VERIFIED feature confirmed or corrected the value.

DetectedBreakBreakType.description:
Enum to denote the type of break found. New line, space etc.

 - UNKNOWN: Unknown break label type.
 - SPACE: Regular space.
 - SURE_SPACE: Sure space (very wide).
 - EOL_SURE_SPACE: Line-wrapping break.
 - HYPHEN: End-line hyphen that is not present in text; does not co-occur with
`SPACE` or `LINE_BREAK`.
 - LINE_BREAK: Line break that ends a paragraph.

isPrefix.description: True if break prepends the element.

TextAnnotationDetectedBreak.description: Detected start or end of a structural component.

languageCode.description:
The BCP-47 language code, such as "en-US" or "sr-Latn". For more
information, see
http://www.unicode.org/reports/tr35/#Unicode_locale_identifier.

TextAnnotationDetectedLanguage.description: Detected language for a structural component.

detectedLanguages.description: A list of detected languages together with confidence.

detectedBreak.description: Detected start or end of a text segment.

TextAnnotationTextProperty.description: Additional information detected on the structural component.

content.description:
The bytes of the file, base64-encoded in JSON. If you send both `content` and
`source`, `content` is used.

source.description: Where to download the document from, when you don't send `content`.

ssnannotatorv1Document.description: A document to scan: a PDF or an image. Send either `content` or `source`.

question.description: The question, as sent in the request.

confidence.description: [NOT IMPLEMENTED] Answers don't have a confidence yet, so this is always empty.

modelMetadata.description: [NOT IMPLEMENTED] Answers don't name a model yet, so this is always empty.

pageRef.description:
The page the answer comes from, starting at 1. It's 1 when Smartscan reads the
first and last page together (see `documentMetadata.pageCount`).

typeAnswerCandidate.description: An answer to one of the questions in the request.

property.description: Additional information detected for the block.

paragraphs.description: The paragraphs in the block, if it's a text block.

blockType.description: Detected block type (text, image etc) for this block.

confidence.description: Confidence of the OCR results on the block. Range [0, 1].

vertices.description: The four points, in pixel coordinates.

normalizedVertices.description:
The same four points relative to the page size, from 0 to 1, so you can place an
overlay without knowing the size of the image.

typeBoundingPoly.description:
A box on the page, for example around the text of a candidate. Its four points are
ordered top-left, top-right, bottom-right and bottom-left. When the box is rotated,
the order follows the text as it's read in its natural orientation, so the first
point is always the top-left corner of the text.

value.description:
The normalized value, for example "2019-01-01" for a date. Each field of the
response describes the format of its values.

text.description: The text as written on the document, for example "1. Jan". Useful for overlays.

pageRef.description: The page the candidate was found on, starting at 1.

corrected.description:
Only set on VERIFIED candidates: true when the consistency checks changed the
value, and false when they confirmed it.

typeCandidate.description:
A candidate value for a field, with its confidence and where it was found. In a
list of candidates, the most confident one comes first.

typeCandidateType.description: The kind of candidate. Not every candidate has one.

value.description: A confidence score. Most responses leave it out and return only the level.

typeConfidence.description: How confident Smartscan is in a candidate.

year.description:
Year of the date. Must be from 1 to 9999, or 0 to specify a date without
a year.

month.description:
Month of a year. Must be from 1 to 12, or 0 to specify a year without a
month and day.

day.description:
Day of a month. Must be from 1 to 31 and valid for the year and month, or 0
to specify a year by itself or a year and month where the day isn't
significant.

typeDate.description:
* A full date, with non-zero year, month, and day values
* A month and day value, with a zero year, such as an anniversary
* A year on its own, with zero month and day values
* A year and month value, with a zero day, such as a credit card expiration
date

Related types are [google.type.TimeOfDay][google.type.TimeOfDay] and
`google.protobuf.Timestamp`.
typeDate.title:
Represents a whole or partial calendar date, such as a birthday. The time of
day and time zone are either specified elsewhere or are insignificant. The
date is relative to the Gregorian Calendar. This can represent one of the
following:

pageCount.description:
The number of pages Smartscan read, not the number of pages in the document. It's
1 when the first and last page are read together, which is the case for field
predictions. When you request a feature that is read page by page, such as
PURCHASE_LINES, PAGE_TEXTS, QR_CODES or SWISS_QR_BILLS, it's the number of pages
read, up to 5.

checkInDate.description: Candidates for the check-in date, as YYYY-MM-DD, for example "2019-12-31".

checkOutDate.description: Candidates for the check-out date, as YYYY-MM-DD, for example "2019-12-31".

typeHotelDates.description:
Check-in and check-out dates on a document related to accommodation, returned for the
HOTEL_DATES feature.

text.description: The text of the line without the amount, for example "3 Dark and Stormy".

amount.description: The amount (price) of the line, normalized, for example 300.0.

pageRef.description: The page the line was found on, starting at 1.

typeLineCandidate.description: A line of the document that holds an amount, returned for the LINES feature.

typeModelSpec.description: The model that produced a candidate.

x.description: The x coordinate, relative to the page width.

y.description: The y coordinate, relative to the page height.

typeNormalizedVertex.description: A point on the page, relative to the page size. Both coordinates range from 0 to 1.

property.description: Additional information detected on the page.

blocks.description: List of blocks of text, images etc on this page.

confidence.description: Confidence of the OCR results on the page. Range [0, 1].

typePageText.description: The text of one page, returned for the PAGE_TEXTS feature.

property.description: Additional information detected for the paragraph.

words.description: List of words in this paragraph.

confidence.description: Confidence of the OCR results for the paragraph. Range [0, 1].

typeParagraph.description: Structural unit of text representing a number of words in certain order.

pageRef.description: The page the line was found on, starting at 1.

code.description:
Candidates for the product code, product number or SKU that the supplier uses for
the item.

description.description:
Candidates for the description of the line, typically the name of a product or the
delivered service.

itemNumber.description: Candidates for the row number, position or ID of the line, if the document states one.

unit.description: Candidates for the unit of the quantity, for example "pieces", "kg" or "lb".

totalDiscount.description: Candidates for the total discount of the line.

percentageDiscount.description: Candidates for the discount rate of the line, as a percentage.

totalInclVat.description: Candidates for the line total including VAT.

totalExclVat.description: Candidates for the line total excluding VAT.

totalVat.description: Candidates for the VAT amount of the line.

percentageVat.description: Candidates for the VAT rate of the line, as a percentage, for example "25.0".

unitPriceInclVat.description: Candidates for the price of one unit, including VAT.

unitPriceExclVat.description: Candidates for the price of one unit, excluding VAT.

total.description:
Candidates for the line total as stated on the line, usually the rightmost amount.
Documents often don't say whether it includes VAT.

unitPrice.description:
Candidates for the price of one unit as stated on the line. Documents often don't
say whether it includes VAT.

productType.description:
Product type candidates for the line, classified from its description. Returned for
the PRODUCT_TYPES feature.

kind.description: Candidates for what the line charges for, for example "item", "freight" or "discount".

typePurchaseLine.description: A purchase line, with a list of candidates for each field.

pageRef.description: The page the line was found on, starting at 1.

code.description: The product code, product number or SKU that the supplier uses for the item.

description.description: The description of the line, typically the name of a product or the delivered service.

itemNumber.description: The row number, position or ID of the line, if the document states one.

unit.description: The unit of the quantity, for example "pieces", "kg" or "lb".

totalDiscount.description: The total discount of the line.

percentageDiscount.description: The discount rate of the line, as a percentage.

totalVat.description: The VAT amount of the line.

percentageVat.description: The VAT rate of the line, as a percentage, for example "25.0".

unitPriceInclVat.description: The price of one unit, including VAT.

unitPriceExclVat.description: The price of one unit, excluding VAT.

total.description:
The line total as stated on the line, usually the rightmost amount. Documents
often don't say whether it includes VAT.

unitPrice.description:
The price of one unit as stated on the line. Documents often don't say whether
it includes VAT.

productType.description:
The product type of the line in the older format. For product types, request
PRODUCT_TYPES and read `productType` in `purchaseLinesDetails`.

typePurchaseLineCandidate.description:
A purchase line in the older format, with a single value for each field. Use
PurchaseLine instead: it has candidates with confidence levels for each field.

content.description: The decoded text of the QR code.

typeQrCodeData.description: A QR code found in the document, returned for the QR_CODES feature.

street.description: The street name, without the house number.

countryCode.description: The country, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in capital letters, for example "DK".

typeStructuredAddress.description: An address split into its parts. All fields are empty when the address can't be resolved.

version.description: The version of the Swiss QR bill standard, always "0200".

account.description: The IBAN or QR-IBAN of the creditor.

creditorAddressType.description: The format of the creditor's address: "S" for structured or "K" for combined.

creditorAddressLine1.description: The street or P.O. box of the creditor, or the first address line.

creditorAddressLine2.description: The building number of the creditor, or the second address line.

creditorAddressPostalCode.description: The postal code of the creditor.

creditorAddressCountry.description: The country of the creditor, as a two-letter code.

ultimateCreditorAddressType.description:
The format of the ultimate creditor's address: "S" for structured or "K" for combined.
Empty when the bill names no ultimate creditor.

ultimateCreditorName.description: The name of the ultimate creditor.

ultimateCreditorAddressLine1.description: The street or P.O. box of the ultimate creditor, or the first address line.

ultimateCreditorAddressLine2.description: The building number of the ultimate creditor, or the second address line.

ultimateCreditorAddressPostalCode.description: The postal code of the ultimate creditor.

ultimateCreditorAddressCity.description: The town of the ultimate creditor.

ultimateCreditorAddressCountry.description: The country of the ultimate creditor, as a two-letter code.

amount.description: The amount to pay, for example "1949.75". Empty when the bill leaves the amount open.

ultimateDebtorAddressType.description:
The format of the ultimate debtor's address: "S" for structured or "K" for combined.
Empty when the bill names no ultimate debtor.

ultimateDebtorName.description: The name of the ultimate debtor.

ultimateDebtorAddressLine1.description: The street or P.O. box of the ultimate debtor, or the first address line.

ultimateDebtorAddressLine2.description: The building number of the ultimate debtor, or the second address line.

ultimateDebtorAddressPostalCode.description: The postal code of the ultimate debtor.

ultimateDebtorAddressCity.description: The town of the ultimate debtor.

ultimateDebtorAddressCountry.description: The country of the ultimate debtor, as a two-letter code.

paymentReferenceType.description:
The reference type: "QRR" for a QR reference, "SCOR" for a creditor reference, or
"NON" for no reference.

unstructuredMessage.description: Additional information for the payment, for example "Order from 15.10.2020".

trailer.description: The end of the payment data, always "EPD".

billingInformation.description: [NOT IMPLEMENTED] Billing information isn't extracted yet, so this is always empty.

av1Parameters.description:
[NOT IMPLEMENTED] Alternative procedure parameters aren't extracted yet, so this is
always empty.

av2Parameters.description:
[NOT IMPLEMENTED] Alternative procedure parameters aren't extracted yet, so this is
always empty.

typeSwissQrBill.description:
A Swiss QR bill parsed from a QR code in the document, returned for the
SWISS_QR_BILLS feature. Only QR codes that follow version 0200 of the Swiss QR bill
standard are returned. The fields hold the values of the QR code as they are.

property.description: Additional information detected for the symbol.

text.description: The actual UTF-8 representation of the symbol.

confidence.description: Confidence of the OCR results for the symbol. Range [0, 1].

text.description: UTF-8 text detected on the pages.

typeTextAnnotation.description:
The OCR output for a document: its text, and its structure from pages down to single
symbols (TextAnnotation, Page, Block, Paragraph, Word, Symbol). Each element from Page
down can have properties, such as the detected languages and breaks.

typeTier.description:
The model tier that processes the document. When no tier is set, PREMIUM is used.

 - DEFAULT: No tier set. The document is processed as PREMIUM.
 - STANDARD: The older tier, kept for existing integrations. Use PREMIUM for new integrations.
 - PREMIUM: Our proprietary AI, and the tier used when no tier is set.
 - ULTRA: Combines our proprietary AI with reasoning LLMs for the highest available quality.
Only available through Smartscan Async. The synchronous API serves it as PREMIUM.

pageRef.description: The page the VAT level was found on, starting at 1.

percentage.description:
Candidates for the VAT rate, as a percentage with a dot as the decimal separator,
for example "25.0".

totalInclVat.description: Candidates for the amount including VAT at this rate.

totalExclVat.description: Candidates for the amount excluding VAT that the VAT is based on.

totalVat.description: Candidates for the VAT amount at this rate.

typeVatDistribution.description: A VAT level, with a list of candidates for each field.

percentage.description: The VAT rate, as a percentage with a dot as the decimal separator, for example "25.0".

amount.description: The VAT amount at this rate, rounded to two decimals, for example "585.45".

pageRef.description: The page the VAT level was found on, starting at 1.

exclVat.description: The amount excluding VAT that the VAT is based on, for example "2341.80".

inclVat.description: The amount including VAT at this rate, for example "2926.25".

typeVatDistributionCandidate.description:
A VAT level in the older format, with a single value for each field. Use
VatDistribution instead: it has candidates with confidence levels for each field.

typeVertex.description: A point on the page, in pixel coordinates.

property.description: Additional information detected for the word.

symbols.description:
List of symbols in the word.
The order of the symbols follows the natural reading order.

confidence.description: Confidence of the OCR results for the word. Range [0, 1].

tags.description:
Feedback with at least one of these tags is deleted. At least one tag is
required.

v1DeleteRequest.description: Tags of the feedback to delete.

document.description:
The document to scan, a PDF or an image. Send its bytes as `content`, or a URL to
download it from as `source.httpUri`.

features.description:
The features to extract, for example `[{"type": "DEFAULT"}]`. Without features,
nothing is extracted.

tags.description:
Labels for the request, such as your customer's ID. They're stored with the
request's usage statistics and don't change the results.

segments.description:
More labels for the request, stored with its usage statistics like `tags`. They
don't change the results.

questions.description:
Questions about the document in plain language, for example "What is the order
reference?". The answers come back in `answers`, one per question for each page
read (see `documentMetadata.pageCount`). If answering takes longer than 10
seconds, the call fails.

paymentDueDate.description: Candidates for the date the payment is due, as YYYY-MM-DD, for example "2019-12-31".

currency.description: Candidates for the currency, as an ISO 4217 code, for example "NOK".

totalVat.description: Candidates for the total VAT, as an absolute amount, for example "11.11".

totalInclVat.description: Candidates for the total including VAT, as an absolute amount, for example "11.11".

totalExclVat.description: Candidates for the total excluding VAT, as an absolute amount, for example "11.11".

supplierCountryCode.description:
Candidates for the supplier's country, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, for example
"NO".

documentType.description: Candidates for the document type, for example "Invoice" or "Receipt".

paymentMethod.description: Candidates for the payment method, for example "Cash" or "CreditCard".

creditCardLastFour.description: Candidates for the last four digits of the credit card, for example "0012".

textAnnotation.description:
The OCR output for the pages Smartscan read: the text and its structure from pages
down to single symbols, with bounding boxes. Returned for TEXT_ANNOTATION.

ocrLineDkType.description: Candidates for the type field of a Danish payment line (FIK).

ocrLineDkPaymentId.description:
Candidates for the payment ID of a Danish payment line (FIK), for example
"000002879094031".

ocrLineDkCreditorId.description:
Candidates for the creditor ID of a Danish payment line (FIK), for example
"86570807".

ocrLineSePaymentId.description: Candidates for the payment ID of a Swedish payment line, for example "050765098".

ocrLineSeBankgiroCreditorId.description:
Candidates for the Bankgiro creditor ID of a Swedish payment line, for example
"2654507".

ocrLineSePlusgiroCreditorId.description:
Candidates for the Plusgiro creditor ID of a Swedish payment line, for example
"5000872".

ocrLineNoPaymentId.description:
Candidates for the payment ID (KID) of a Norwegian payment line, for example
"12345678903".

ocrLineFiPaymentId.description:
Candidates for the payment ID (viitenumero) of a Finnish payment line, for example
"0817937867870002".

ocrLineNlPaymentId.description:
Candidates for the payment ID (betalingskenmerk) of a Dutch payment line, for
example "00000159220010146012".

ocrLineBePaymentId.description:
Candidates for the payment ID (OGM) of a Belgian payment line, for example
"+++123/1234/12345+++".

text.description: The text of the pages Smartscan read, as UTF-8. Returned for TEXT.

feedbackId.description:
The ID of this request. To correct the results, send it as `id` to
POST /v1/feedback:create.

iban.description:
Candidates for the IBAN, for example "DK50 0040 0440 1162 43" or
"NO8330001234567". The first two letters are a country code, and the next two
digits are check digits (ISO 7064 Mod 97-10).

lines.description:
The lines of the document that hold an amount, with their text, amount and page.
Returned for LINES.

preview.description: A base64-encoded image of the first page that holds text. Returned for PREVIEW.

bankAccountNumber.description: Candidates for the bank account number, in the format of its country.

bankRegistrationNumber.description:
Candidates for the bank registration number, in countries that use one, such as
Denmark.

bic.description: Candidates for the BIC (SWIFT code), for example "DABADKKK".

documentNumber.description: Candidates for the number that identifies the document, such as the invoice number.

documentDate.description:
Candidates for the date the document was issued, as YYYY-MM-DD, for example
"2019-12-31".

supplierVatNumber.description: [EXPERIMENTAL] Candidates for the supplier's VAT number.

supplierOrganisationNumber.description:
[EXPERIMENTAL] Candidates for the supplier's national company ID, such as the
CVR number in Denmark or the KvK number in the Netherlands.

supplierAddress.description:
[EXPERIMENTAL] Candidates for the supplier's address, as written on the document.
See `structuredSupplierAddress` for its parts.

customerNumber.description: [EXPERIMENTAL] Candidates for the number that identifies the customer.

receiverOrderNumber.description: Candidates for the receiver's order number.

receiverAddress.description:
Candidates for the receiver's address, as written on the document. See
`structuredReceiverAddress` for its parts.

receiverCountryCode.description: Candidates for the receiver's country, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

receiverVatNumber.description: Candidates for the receiver's VAT number.

purchaseLines.description:
The purchase lines in the older format, with one value for each field. Use
`purchaseLinesDetails` instead: it has candidates with confidence levels, and
VERIFIED results.

answers.description: The answers to the `questions` in the request, one per question for each page read.

pageTexts.description: The text of each page read. Returned for PAGE_TEXTS.

vatDistribution.description:
The VAT levels in the older format, with one value for each field. Use
`vatDistributionDetails` instead: it has candidates with confidence levels, and
VERIFIED results.

documentMetadata.description:
Information about how the document was processed, such as the number of pages
Smartscan read.

languageCode.description: Candidates for the language of the document text, as a BCP-47 code such as "en".

qrCodes.description: The QR codes found on the pages read. Returned for QR_CODES.

swissQrBills.description: The Swiss QR bills found in QR codes on the pages read. Returned for SWISS_QR_BILLS.

hotelDates.description:
Check-in and check-out date candidates on documents related to accommodation, as
YYYY-MM-DD. Returned for HOTEL_DATES.

purchaseLinesDetails.description:
The purchase lines, with a list of candidates for each field. Returned for
PURCHASE_LINES and PRODUCT_TYPES, and read from the first 5 pages.

vatDistributionDetails.description:
The VAT levels, with a list of candidates for each field. Returned for
VAT_DISTRIBUTION.

structuredSupplierAddress.description:
The supplier address split into its parts, returned for SUPPLIER_ADDRESS. Each entry
belongs to the `supplierAddress` candidate at the same index, and is empty when that
address can't be resolved.

structuredReceiverAddress.description:
The receiver address split into its parts, returned for RECEIVER_ADDRESS. Each entry
belongs to the `receiverAddress` candidate at the same index, and is empty when that
address can't be resolved.

ksef.description:
Candidates for the Polish KSeF (Krajowy System e-Faktur) e-invoice number: 35
characters made of the seller's 10-digit NIP, an 8-digit date, a 12-character
technical part and a 2-character checksum, separated by hyphens. Only numbers with
a valid checksum are returned.

v1DocumentAnnotatorResponse.description:
Response of POST /v1/document:annotate. Feature fields are only filled for the
features you requested.

questions.description: Questions about the document, in plain language.

v1DocumentQuestionRequest.description: Request body of POST /v1/document:answerquestion, which isn't implemented.

v1DocumentQuestionResponse.description: Response of POST /v1/document:answerquestion, which isn't implemented.

httpUri.description:
A public HTTP or HTTPS URL of the document. The server must use port 80 or 443,
answer with HTTP 200 and a Content-Length header, and send at most 10 MiB.
POST /v1/document:annotate waits 2 seconds for it, and async transactions wait 10
seconds. When the download fails, the call returns 400.

v1DocumentSource.description: A location to download a document from.

maxResults.description:
The maximum number of candidates to return for this feature. Defaults to 1. It
doesn't apply to PURCHASE_LINES, VAT_DISTRIBUTION, PAGE_TEXTS, QR_CODES,
SWISS_QR_BILLS, HOTEL_DATES and KSEF, or to features without candidates, such as
TEXT.

minConfidence.description:
The lowest confidence level to return candidates for. Defaults to HIGH. The levels
from lowest to highest are VERY_LOW, LOW, MID, HIGH, VERY_HIGH and VERIFIED. It
applies to the same features as `maxResults`, except LANGUAGE_CODE, which returns
candidates of any level.

v1Feature.description: A feature to extract, with optional limits on its candidates.

v1FeatureType.description:
The features Smartscan can extract. Each feature's results come back in the
response field of the same name, in camelCase, unless noted otherwise.

 - DEFAULT: A set of frequently used fields: PAYMENT_DUE_DATE, CURRENCY, TOTAL_VAT,
TOTAL_INCL_VAT, TOTAL_EXCL_VAT, SUPPLIER_COUNTRY_CODE, DOCUMENT_TYPE,
PAYMENT_METHOD, CREDIT_CARD_LAST_FOUR, DOCUMENT_NUMBER, DOCUMENT_DATE and
SUPPLIER_ORGANISATION_NUMBER. Its `maxResults` and `minConfidence` apply to each
of them, unless you also request that feature on its own.
 - TEXT_ANNOTATION: The full OCR output for the pages Smartscan read.
 - ORDER_DATE: [DEPRECATED] No longer returns anything. Use DOCUMENT_DATE instead.
 - PAYMENT_DUE_DATE: The date the payment is due.
 - CURRENCY: The currency, as a three-letter code.
 - TOTAL_VAT: The total VAT of the document.
 - TOTAL_INCL_VAT: The total of the document including VAT.
 - TOTAL_EXCL_VAT: The total of the document excluding VAT.
 - SUPPLIER_CORPORATE_ID: [DEPRECATED] No longer returns anything. Use SUPPLIER_ORGANISATION_NUMBER or
SUPPLIER_VAT_NUMBER instead.
 - SUPPLIER_COUNTRY_CODE: The supplier's country, as a two-letter code.
 - DOCUMENT_TYPE: The type of document, for example an invoice or a receipt.
 - PAYMENT_METHOD: How the document was paid, for example in cash or by credit card.
 - CREDIT_CARD_LAST_FOUR: The last four digits of the credit card used for the payment.
 - INVOICE_NUMBER: [DEPRECATED] No longer returns anything. Use DOCUMENT_NUMBER instead.
 - OCR_LINE_DK_TYPE: The type field of a Danish payment line (FIK).
 - OCR_LINE_DK_PAYMENT_ID: The payment ID of a Danish payment line (FIK).
 - OCR_LINE_DK_CREDITOR_ID: The creditor ID of a Danish payment line (FIK account number).
 - OCR_LINE_SE_PAYMENT_ID: The payment ID of a Swedish payment line.
 - OCR_LINE_SE_BANKGIRO_CREDITOR_ID: The Bankgiro creditor ID of a Swedish payment line.
 - OCR_LINE_SE_PLUSGIRO_CREDITOR_ID: The Plusgiro creditor ID of a Swedish payment line.
 - OCR_LINE_NO_PAYMENT_ID: The payment ID (KID) of a Norwegian payment line.
 - OCR_LINE_FI_PAYMENT_ID: The payment ID (viitenumero) of a Finnish payment line.
 - OCR_LINE_NL_PAYMENT_ID: The payment ID (betalingskenmerk) of a Dutch payment line.
 - OCR_LINE_BE_PAYMENT_ID: The payment ID (OGM) of a Belgian payment line.
 - TEXT: The text of the pages Smartscan read.
 - IBAN: The IBAN.
 - LINES: The lines of the document that hold an amount.
 - PREVIEW: A base64-encoded image of the first page that holds text.
 - BANK_ACCOUNT_NUMBER: The bank account number.
 - BANK_REGISTRATION_NUMBER: The bank registration number, in countries that use one, such as Denmark.
 - BIC: The BIC (SWIFT code).
 - DOCUMENT_NUMBER: The number that identifies the document, such as the invoice number.
 - DOCUMENT_DATE: The date the document was issued.
 - ORDER_NUMBER: The order number.
 - SUPPLIER_NAME: The supplier's name.
 - SUPPLIER_VAT_NUMBER: [EXPERIMENTAL] The supplier's VAT number.
 - SUPPLIER_ORGANISATION_NUMBER: [EXPERIMENTAL] The supplier's national company ID, such as the CVR number in Denmark.
 - SUPPLIER_ADDRESS: [EXPERIMENTAL] The supplier's address. Also returns `structuredSupplierAddress`.
 - CUSTOMER_NUMBER: [EXPERIMENTAL] The number that identifies the customer.
 - RECEIVER_ORDER_NUMBER: The receiver's order number.
 - RECEIVER_ADDRESS: The receiver's address. Also returns `structuredReceiverAddress`.
 - RECEIVER_COUNTRY_CODE: The receiver's country, as a two-letter code.
 - RECEIVER_NAME: The receiver's name.
 - RECEIVER_VAT_NUMBER: The receiver's VAT number.
 - PURCHASE_LINES: The line items, in `purchaseLinesDetails` and, in the older format, in
`purchaseLines`. Read from the first 5 pages.
 - PAGE_TEXTS: The text of each page. Read from the first 5 pages.
 - VAT_DISTRIBUTION: The VAT levels and their amounts, in `vatDistributionDetails` and, in the older
format, in `vatDistribution`. Read from the first and last page.
 - LANGUAGE_CODE: The language of the document text. Returned regardless of `minConfidence`.
 - QR_CODES: The decoded text of QR codes. Read from the first 5 pages.
 - SWISS_QR_BILLS: Swiss QR bills found in QR codes. Read from the first 5 pages.
 - VERIFIED: Runs consistency checks on the extracted values. Candidates that the checks
confirm or correct get the confidence level VERIFIED. Also requests
DOCUMENT_DATE, DOCUMENT_NUMBER, DOCUMENT_TYPE, PAYMENT_DUE_DATE, PAYMENT_METHOD,
CURRENCY, CREDIT_CARD_LAST_FOUR, TOTAL_VAT, TOTAL_INCL_VAT, TOTAL_EXCL_VAT,
SUPPLIER_COUNTRY_CODE, RECEIVER_COUNTRY_CODE, SUPPLIER_ADDRESS, RECEIVER_ADDRESS,
PURCHASE_LINES and VAT_DISTRIBUTION. Verified line and VAT values are in
`purchaseLinesDetails` and `vatDistributionDetails`.
 - HOTEL_DATES: The check-in and check-out dates on documents related to accommodation.
 - PRODUCT_TYPES: A product type for each purchase line, in `productType` of
`purchaseLinesDetails`. Also requests PURCHASE_LINES.
 - KSEF: The Polish KSeF (Krajowy System e-Faktur) e-invoice number.

id.description: The `feedbackId` from the annotate response for the document. Required.

tags.description:
Labels to store with the feedback, for example your customer's ID. To
delete the feedback later, call POST /v1/feedback:delete with one of
them. Tags sent with the annotate request aren't copied to the feedback.

completable.description: Completable gate probability, from mlservice PredictResponse.completable.

totalInclVat.description: Total including VAT, as a number.

totalExclVat.description: Total excluding VAT, as a number.

paymentDueDate.description:
Last day for the payment, as an object with year, month and day. The day
must be 1 to 31 and the month 1 to 12, or the call returns 400.

documentType.description:
Document type, using the values the annotate response returns, for
example "Invoice".

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, for example "DKK".

creditCardLastFour.description: Last four digits of the card used for payment, for example "2345".

paymentMethod.description:
Payment method, using the values the annotate response returns: "Cash",
"CreditCard" or "BankTransfer".

ocrLineDkType.description: Type field of a Danish FIK payment line.

ocrLineDkPaymentId.description: Payment reference of a Danish FIK payment line.

ocrLineDkCreditorId.description: Creditor account number of a Danish FIK payment line.

ocrLineSeBankgiroCreditorId.description: Swedish Bankgiro number of the creditor.

ocrLineSePlusgiroCreditorId.description: Swedish PlusGiro number of the creditor.

supplierCountryCode.description:
Supplier's country, as a two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, for
example "DK".

orderReference.description: Order reference on the document. No Smartscan feature extracts it.

bankRegistrationNumber.description: Bank registration number, in countries that use one, such as Denmark.

documentNumber.description: Number that identifies the document, such as the invoice number.

documentDate.description:
Date the document was issued, as an object with year, month and day. The
day must be 1 to 31 and the month 1 to 12, or the call returns 400.

orderNumber.description: Order number, if the document shows one.

supplierOrganisationNumber.description:
National company ID of the supplier, such as the CVR number in Denmark or
the KvK number in the Netherlands.

ocrLineBePaymentId.description:
Belgian structured payment reference (OGM), for example
"+++123/1234/12345+++".

receiverCountryCode.description: Receiver's country, as a two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

purchaseLines.description:
Purchase lines, in the same format as `purchaseLines` in the annotate
response.

answers.description:
Answers to the questions asked in the annotate request, in the same
format as `answers` in the annotate response.

vatDistribution.description:
VAT levels, in the same format as `vatDistribution` in the annotate
response.

checkInDate.description:
Check-in date on an accommodation document, as an object with year,
month and day.

checkOutDate.description:
Check-out date on an accommodation document, as an object with year,
month and day.

v1TrueValues.description:
The correct values for a document, as your user confirmed them. Send the
final value of each field your user reviewed, whether they kept the
suggestion or changed it. Field names match the annotate response.

sub.description:
Optional. Who the key is for, for example your user's ID. It's stored in
the token as its subject (the `sub` claim).

exp.description:
When the key expires, as a Unix timestamp in seconds. At most 48 hours
from now. Defaults to 8 hours after the key is issued.

v1ValetKeyRequest.description: Options for a new valet key.

id.description: Unique ID of the key, also stored in the token as its `jti` claim.

token.description:
The valet key, a signed JSON Web Token (JWT). Send it as
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

v2ConfidenceLevel.description:
Confidence level of a product type candidate, from VERY_LOW to VERY_HIGH. UNKNOWN means the
model gave no level.

v2ProductType.description:
The product types a text can be classified into. UNDEFINED isn't a product type: it's the
empty value.

type.description:
The product type, such as ACCOUNTING_SOFTWARE. It's left out when the model returns a
label that has no product type.

label.description: The product type's name in words, such as "Accounting software".

confidence.description:
The model's confidence score for this candidate. Use confidenceLevel to decide whether to
trust it.

v2ProductTypeCandidate.description: A product type candidate for a text.
